comparison.title:
SafeTools vs.

Cloud Generators
comparison.description: Most online password generators are "Black Boxes." You have no way of knowing if your generated password is being logged on a remote server.

advantage.title: The Browser Advantage
advantage.description: By using the **Web Crypto API**, SafeTools ensures that your password is never even "seen" by our own application code in a readable state on a server. The extraction happens in a sandbox environment that is destroyed the moment you close the tab.

entropy.title: The Entropy Scale
entropy.description: Entropy measures the absolute unpredictability of a secret. The higher the bit-count, the more centuries it would take modern supercomputers to crack your password.

hygiene.title:
Mastering Password

Hygiene
hygiene.description: A secure password is only the first step. Follow these industry standards to protect your digital footprint.

items.d: Never reuse a password. If one service is breached, your entire identity becomes vulnerable. Use a generator for every new account.
A strong password is your first line of defense, but MFA (TOTP, Security Keys) provides a critical second layer.
Never include birthdays, pet names, or addresses. Our generator eliminates these predictable patterns entirely.
Store your high-entropy SafeTools passwords in a reputable, encrypted manager so you never have to remember them.

items.q: How does the password generator create 'truly random' passwords?
items.a: SafeTools uses the Web Crypto API, which provides a Cryptographically Secure Pseudo-Random Number Generator (CSPRNG). Unlike standard random functions, this extracts high-quality randomness (entropy) from your operating system's underlying security layer, making the generated passwords mathematically impossible to predict.

items.q: Is it safer to generate a password offline?
items.a: Yes. By generating your password locally in your browser with SafeTools, you eliminate the risk of 'man-in-the-middle' attacks where a server-side generator could be intercepted or logged. Your generated secrets exist only in your browser's memory.

items.q: Can I generate passwords for all types of accounts?
items.a: Absolutely. You can customize the length and include uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, and symbols to meet the specific requirements of any website or application while maintaining maximum security.

items.q: Why does SafeTools not store my generated passwords?
items.a: Our core philosophy is 'Zero-Server' privacy. Storing passwords on a server creates a centralized target for hackers. By not storing anything, we ensure that you are the only person who ever sees your generated secret.

items.q: What is the recommended password length for 2026?
items.a: For critical accounts like email or banking, we recommend a minimum of 16 to 24 characters. Our tool defaults to 24 characters to provide high-entropy protection that is resistant to modern brute-force and dictionary attacks.
